source_caption:
Kindred (2022) is a psychological drama series based on Octavia E. Butler’s acclaimed novel. The story follows Dana, a young Black woman who suddenly finds herself transported from her life in modern-day Los Angeles to a plantation in 19th-century Maryland.
Each time Dana is pulled into the past, she becomes connected to people whose lives are tied to her own family history. What initially seems impossible becomes increasingly frightening as she realizes that the events of the past may be directly connected to her existence in the present.
Dana must navigate a world shaped by slavery, violence, and an oppressive social system while trying to understand why she keeps being transported through time. At the same time, she is determined to find a way back home and uncover the truth behind her connection to the people she encounters.
The series explores themes of identity, family, history, survival, power, and the lasting impact of the past. Dana's journey forces her to confront a history that is not distant or abstract—it is connected directly to her own family.
What makes Kindred compelling is the way it combines time travel with a deeply personal story. Dana is not simply witnessing history; she is forced to experience it while trying to understand how the past shaped the present.
More than just a time-travel drama, Kindred is a story about family history and the difficult realities that can remain connected across generations.
💬 What would you do if you were suddenly forced to live through the history of your own family?

source_details.title: The Kindred
source_details.synopsis: The Kindred is a 2021 British psychological horror film written by Christian J. Hearn and directed by Jamie Patterson that stars April Pearson, Samantha Bond, James Cosmo, Patrick Bergin, James Dreyfus, Blake Harrison and Robbie Gee. It was released on 26 August 2021.
